# Security

This is the netplay fork of [sciaschi/CBFD-Recompiled](https://github.com/sciaschi/CBFD-Recompiled). Its
netplay code talks to other computers over the internet (host/src/netplay/, the packets and the session in
host/src/netplay/net/), so a flaw there could matter to the people playing.

**Please report a security problem privately**, not as a public issue: use **Report a vulnerability** on this
repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/easymod0/CBFD-Recompiled-Netplay/security/advisories/new).
Say what an attacker could do, and how (a packet, a join code, a recording or save state, a release file).

Problems in the rest of the game belong upstream. Only the latest release is supported.
